title: persicaria minor subsp. depressa
intro: Persicaria minor subsp. depressa, commonly known as Lesser Spearwort or Water Clover, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Polygonaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Persicaria minor subsp. depressa include its ability to act as an antiseptic, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a potential treatment for various conditions such as wounds, skin issues, and respiratory problems. Bioactive constituents of Persicaria minor subsp. depressa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
